messages.text:
Professor Alvarez,

Following our talk in the hallway — you said your faculty senate meeting at 10:00 this Wednesday is cancelled, so you'd be free that hour even though your calendar still shows it. Could we put a 30-minute meeting in that slot, Wednesday 10:00?

If it turns out the senate meeting is back on, or 10:00 doesn't suit after all, tell me a time and I'll fit around it.

— Diego
One moment, Diego — checking my calendar.

Diego,

Yes — Wednesday 10:00 works. I've removed the faculty senate meeting from my calendar and booked us 10:00-10:30. Bring the outline you mentioned.

— Professor Alvarez

Professor Alvarez — to be precise about the date: Wednesday 25 November, 10:00–10:30, the hour freed by your cancelled senate meeting.

May I count on it? Your calendar still shows the senate meeting at that hour, so you may want to clear it there too. If anything has changed, give me a time and I'll fit around it.

— Diego

Thank you — I'll be there Wednesday 10:00 with the outline.

— Diego

Confirmed for Wednesday 25 November, 10:00-10:30. The senate meeting is already off my calendar — I cleared it when we spoke, and that hour is now held for you.

— Professor Alvarez
